candidates.issues: The ingredient line "1 ليمونة قشر ليمون مبشور" is redundant and awkward. "2 بيض كبير" has weak number agreement. Otherwise accurate and natural.
"سكر ناعم" can be read as powdered sugar rather than granulated. "1 ليمونة قشر ليمون" is awkward. "تتضاعف" lacks حجمها. Otherwise fluent.
Adds explicit details (oil, granulated sugar) in the steps, which is harmless. "لمدة 2 دقيقة" is less natural than دقيقتين. "القطع" is used repetitively.
"سكر حبيبات" is slightly unidiomatic. "2 دقيقة" should be دقيقتين. "1 بشر ليمون" is a bit terse.
"بسكر الحبيبات" and "سكر حبيبات" are awkward. "2 دقيقة" should be دقيقتين. "غطّ" is missing its kasra. "2 بيض كبير" has weak agreement.
Better agreement in "بيضة كبيرة" (ideally بيضتان). "تتخمر" and "دقيقتين" read naturally. Only minor nitpicks.
